en-US.description: Okteto is a cloud-native development platform that bridges the gap between local development and production, enabling seamless development and deployment in Kubernetes clusters.
en-US.name: okteto
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
New Feature
- feat(compose): support x-okteto-service-account per service by @bgonp in #5184
- feat(compose): fail fast when an x-okteto-service-account doesn't exist by @bgonp in #5188
- feat(deploy): deploy dependencies in parallel following depends_on by @jLopezbarb in #5200
Bug Fix
- fix: okteto destroy command removes manifest information from config map ev... by @Roshan931 in #5171
- fix: keep protocol when expanding compose port ranges by @Sarthak-Shreshtha01 in #5178
- fix: report failed init containers during okteto up by @deepanshupal in #5181
- fix(build): request a new BuildKit pod when the session's pod is gone by @jLopezbarb in #5189
- fix: wait until the namespace is fully deleted in okteto namespace delete by @jLopezbarb in #5187
New Contributors
- @Roshan931 made their first contribution in #5171
- @Sarthak-Shreshtha01 made their first contribution in #5178
- @bgonp made their first contribution in #5184
- @deepanshupal made their first contribution in #5181
